title: Faulty label printer dead on arrival, warranty replacement
notes: Exercises a hardware fault escalated for a warranty replacement, with a follow-up routed to the returns team. All data is synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: SSM Repak hardware support, you're speaking with Noah. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Hello Noah, this is Hannah de Jong. The label printer I received last week won't power on at all.
Speaker 1: I'm sorry about that, Hannah. Can I get the order reference for the printer?
Speaker 1: Thank you. Let's check a few things. Is the power cable fully seated at both ends, and have you tried a different wall socket?
Speaker 2: Yes, I tried two sockets and a second power cable. The unit is completely dead, no lights, no sound.

Speaker 1: That points to a faulty unit rather than a power issue. Since it's under a week old it's covered by warranty. I can't issue the replacement from this desk though, it has to go through our returns team.
Speaker 2: So I have to wait again? I needed this printer for a deadline.
Speaker 1: I understand, and I'll mark the case as high priority. I'll escalate it to the returns team so they can arrange a replacement and a collection of the faulty unit.
Speaker 2: Fine. How will I hear back?
Speaker 1: They'll call you to arrange it. Is this number the best one?
Speaker 1: Got it. I've escalated a warranty replacement to the returns team and they'll contact you on that number.
